text:
ravi: rolled canary of mistral4-int8v2 to 5% in staging and immediately saw p95 token latency jump ~18% and KV hit-rate drop ~6%. putting a hold and posting logs.

tess: can you paste the profiler dump and kernel selection trace? do we have per-layer stats?

ravi: paste below (trimmed):
```
$ runtimed-prof --model mistral4 --quant int8v2 --seq-dist mix --out=prof.json
kernel_decision: INT8_V2 selected, fallback=FP8_V1 on probe failures
overall_tokens_sec: baseline 420 -> canary 345
p95_token_ms: 12.2ms -> 14.5ms
kv_hit_rate: 0.90 -> 0.84
layer_hotspot: layers 16-23 show 3x increase in L2_miss_rate
per_layer_latency_spike: layer_19:+45%
```

omar: that L2 miss spike with layer-locality smells like a per-layer allocator/kvcopy pattern change. did the int8 kernel change how we pack kv shards in memory?

kevin: good call. recent INT8_V2 introduced a different tile packing to align for 8-bit GEMMs; might increase working set for some layers. also check activation quant clamp ranges.

sachin: important: our calibration set for int8v2 was heavy on short chat snippets (<=64). live traffic here is long context-heavy prompts and some system messages. quant scales diverge with different length distributions.

ravi: i used samples/chat-short-2026-03 as calib input. mistake. i will re-run with length-conditioned mix (short/mid/long).

jia: propose these mitigations:
- immediate: flip canary to use hybrid per-layer map `hybrid-map-v1` that keeps layers 16-23 in FP8 and int8 elsewhere. this avoids a full rollback.
- short-term: rebuild quant profiles with length-conditioned calibration sets and per-head outlier clamping. name: mistral4-int8-lenmix-0319
- runtime: add `kv_aware_batching=true` for canary to keep KV occupancy stable under INT8 packing

ravi: ok i'll update canary to hybrid-map-v1 and enable kv_aware_batching flag. will also capture full per-layer kv occupancy histogram.

kevin: also dump per-head max/min and sparsity counts. some Mistral heads have extreme outliers that push scales; clamping 99.9pct could stabilize.

omar: small note: if we use hybrid per-layer, ensure kernel selector honors per-layer policy instead of global preference. we merged a change last month but selector still prefers global if probe window < 200ms.

ops-bot: deploy 2026-03-19T09:12Z canary update (mistral4 hybrid-map-v1, kv_aware_batching=true) :white_check_mark:

ravi: after hybrid flip canary p95 back to 12.6ms, kv_hit_rate 0.89. I posted raw histograms at https://drive.re/redwood/mistral4/prof/1934012345 (restricted).

tess: sounds like calibration length mix + per-head clamping are next actions. also let's schedule a microbenchmark that replicates long-prefix traffic and run kernel microbench (measure L1/L2/RAM footprint).

sachin: action list:
- re-run length-conditioned calib (ravi) -> produce profile `mistral4-int8-lenmix-0319`
- add per-head 99.9th clamp in quantizer -> baseline test (sachin)
- run microbench long-prefix workload and kernel memory footprint (omar)
- update kernel-selector probe window to prefer per-layer policy when per-layer map present (jia)
- run 48h canary and compare unit-cost and quality metrics (kevin)

ravi: i'll open a tracking issue and attach artifacts. thanks all. :thumbsup:

kevin: if re-calib still shows instability, consider dynamic per-request precision hinting: low-latency short requests use INT8, long-prefix requests route to FP8 or hybrid map. not ideal but possible as temporary routing rule.

jia: i'll draft a runtime flag `int8_rollback_guard` to prevent mass rollouts until we validate the new profiles. PR coming.

ravi: logged issue #5907 "mistral4 int8v2 perf regression -> hybrid per-layer stopgap" assigned eng-ml. keeping canary until we have lenmix profile and 24h stability.
